title: A matrix opened from a category shows the category in the breadcrumb
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix made for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Click matrix A's name on category A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A's page opens, not a dialog.
  • The breadcrumb reads Categories › category A's name › matrix A's name.
  • The breadcrumb starts at Categories, with no Settings crumb before it.
